_note: Every value was checked against the IRCC CRS criteria page (date modified 2026-11-03) on 2026-11-05. From 3 November 2026 Canadian work experience and high-wage job offers are scored together in the core Labour Market Integration factor: either the experience path or the job offer, not both.
_maxTotalNote: Sum of the section maximums on the IRCC page since 3 Nov 2026: core 570 (single) or core 530 + spouse 40, + transferability 100 + additional 600. The page itself states no grand total.

coreHumanCapital._note: Section A: Core/human capital factors. Two tables: withSpouse (when spouse/CL partner is coming to Canada) and withoutSpouse.

age._note: Points for age. withSpouse table has lower maximums. Key: age as string (exact year). 17-or-under and 45-or-more score 0. Peak 110 / 100 at ages 20 to 29.

education._note: 8 education tiers. Keys 0–7 correspond to EducationLevel enum. Tier 0 = less than secondary.

_enumMapping.2: One-year post-secondary program certificate or diploma
_enumMapping.3: Two-year post-secondary program certificate or diploma
_enumMapping.4: Bachelor's degree OR three or more year post-secondary program
_enumMapping.5: Two or more certificates, diplomas, or degrees — one must be for a program of three or more years
_enumMapping.6: Master's degree, OR professional degree needed to practice in a licensed profession

firstOfficialLanguage._note: Points per CLB level, per ability (speaking/listening/reading/writing). Each ability scored separately. withoutSpouse and withSpouse tables. CLB 1-3 = 0 pts, CLB 4 starts scoring.
firstOfficialLanguage._clbRange: CLB 1-12. Values below CLB 4 award 0 points. CLB 10+ treated as CLB 10 for point calculation.

secondOfficialLanguage._note: Points per CLB level per ability for second official language. Lower points than first language. CLB 5+ threshold to begin scoring. Combined maximum 24 without a spouse, 22 with a spouse.

canadianWorkExperience._note: Work-length points of the Labour Market Integration factor (Canadian work experience path); values unchanged on 3 Nov 2026. 5+ years treated as 5.

labourMarketIntegration._note: New 3 November 2026. Points for EITHER Canadian work experience (work length above + high-wage experience) OR a high-wage job offer, not both. The page does not say how the two are compared; this engine applies the higher. Maximum 150 without a spouse, 140 with. No LMIA is needed for job-offer points.

highWageExperience._note: At least 12 months (combined) of Canadian work experience in occupations whose median wage is at least this multiple of the median wage. Same with or without a spouse. Needs at least 1 year of Canadian work experience.

jobOffer._note: Job offer in an occupation whose median wage is at least this multiple of the median wage. Same with or without a spouse.

spouseFactors._note: Section B: Spouse or common-law partner factors. Only applicable when spouse is coming to Canada. Max 40 points.

firstOfficialLanguage._note: Per ability, per CLB. Max 20 points (5 per ability × 4 abilities). CLB 1–4 = 0.

skillTransferability._note: Section C: Skill transferability factors. Maximum 100 points total across all combinations. Five official combinations.

educationLanguage._note: Education × First official language (CLB). A bachelor's alone sits in the post-secondary row (13/25); the 25/50 row is two or more credentials with one of 3+ years, a master's or entry-to-practice professional degree, or a doctorate.

foreignExpLanguage._note: Foreign work experience × First official language CLB.

foreignExpCanadianExp._note: Foreign work experience × Canadian work experience.

certificateLanguage._note: Certificate of qualification (trades) × First official language CLB.

additionalPoints._note: Section D: Additional points. Provincial nomination, French, Canadian education, sibling. Job offers moved to the core Labour Market Integration factor on 3 November 2026.

frenchLanguage._note: NCLC 7+ in all 4 French abilities required. Two tiers based on English ability. Effective since 2023 French-stream expansion.

siblingInCanada._note: Sibling who is a Canadian citizen or permanent resident.
